Group rides in Oklahoma

8 recurring group rides around Oklahoma: 6 road, 5 social, 1 mountain bike. 5 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Edmond Tuesday Casual Ride in Edmond — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Tuesday Evening Leisurely Ride runs up to three no-drop groups: 8–11, 11–15 and 15–18 mph.
